With this API, you can programmatically manage investors, send subscription and redemption orders, and access real-time portfolio information.

post.description:
**Register a new investor with the platform.**

- The investor is always created with status `pending-onboarding-workflow` while compliance checks (PEP/sanctions screening) run asynchronously.
- Once checks complete successfully, the investor is automatically transitioned to `active` (if the distributor has KYC reliance enabled). The distributor is notified of the status change via webhook.

**Related persons requirements:**
- Each related person must include `dateOfBirth`, `nationality`, and `countryOfResidence` (required for compliance screening).
- **Organization** investors must provide all their UBOs and directors. FR organizations are exempt (persons are automatically fetched from INPI), unless the distributor operates under a **KYC reliance agreement with Spiko** in which case all UBOs and directors must be provided regardless of country.
- For **passive NFE** investors (`fatcaCrsStatus: "passiveNFE"`), non-FR UBOs must include a `fiscalIdentificationNumber`.

**FATCA/CRS status:**
- Organization investors must provide a `fatcaCrsStatus` in the `details` object. When set to `passiveNFE`, non-FR UBOs must include a `fiscalIdentificationNumber`.

- Pagination parameters (`page` & `limit`) are optional and default to `page = 1` and `limit = 50`.
- Use `textSearch` to filter investors by ID, name (first/last/legal), or email.

get.description:
**Retrieve deposit instructions for a given account, share class, and subscription currency.**

Returns a list of virtual bank accounts, each with its supported payment rails. An empty list means no virtual bank account has been provisioned (feature not available).

When `subscriptionCurrency` differs from the share class currency, the instructions point to the investor's virtual bank account on the share class of the same fund denominated in `subscriptionCurrency` (a `SAFOd` deposit in `EUR` is funded through the `eurSAFOd` virtual IBAN). The request fails with `NoDepositAccountInCurrencyError` (422) when the account has no active line on that share class.

Each entry includes payment informations and supported rails:
- `SCT` / `SCT Instant` - SEPA Credit Transfer (EUR)
- `Faster Payments` / `CHAPS` / `BACS` - UK local transfers (GBP); also includes `gbpLocalDetails` with sort code and account number
- `SWIFT` - international wire

The response also lists stablecoin deposit accounts under `stablecoinDepositAccounts`: one deposit address per supported network, provisioned on demand the first time instructions are requested. Each address accepts every stablecoin listed in its `stablecoins` field (independent of `subscriptionCurrency`); sending a supported stablecoin to it automatically creates and funds a subscription. An empty list means stablecoin deposits are not available for this account and share class (the feature requires an organization, or an individual with a tax identification number on file, on supported share classes).

post.description:
**Create a new withdrawal order for an investor with the specified parameters.**

- The `destination` field supports three modes:
  - `{"type":"bank-transfer","bankAccountId":"..."}` - pay out by bank transfer to one of the investor's bank accounts
  - `{"type":"instant-bank-transfer","bankAccountId":"..."}` - **instant withdrawal**: pay out the same day by instant bank transfer to one of the investor's bank accounts, without waiting for the standard settlement cycle
  - `{"type":"stablecoin-transfer","walletId":"..."}` - pay out in stablecoin to one of the investor's external wallets (organizations or individuals with a tax identification number, on supported share classes)
- The top-level `bankAccountId` field is a deprecated shorthand for the bank-transfer destination; provide exactly one of `destination` or `bankAccountId`.
- The `quantity` field supports three modes:
  - `{"mode":"amount","amount":{"value":"1000","currency":"USD"}}` - withdraw a specific fiat amount
  - `{"mode":"shares","shares":"10.5"}` - withdraw a specific number of shares
  - `{"mode":"total"}` - withdraw all shares (full withdrawal)
- If the order is expressed in shares or if it is total, the currency used will be the bank account currency.
- Returns complete order details, including its UUID identifier.
- **Instant withdrawals** carry extra conditions: your distributor must be enabled for them, the share class must be `EUTBL` or `eurSAFO`, the amount must be in `EUR` and within the investor's remaining daily instant limit, the destination bank account must be validated, and its bank must accept instant transfers. They are executed straight away and cannot be canceled.

> **Distribute-with-Spiko's-license distributors** cannot place this order from their backend. The investor must place it directly from the browser with a short-lived [Investor JWT](/developers/distributor_api/technical_guides/investor_jwt), targeting the investor-scoped path **`POST /v0/investor/withdrawal-orders/`** (identical payload and response, but authenticated with the investor JWT as bearer token instead of your API credentials).

post.description:
**Move an investor's holdings directly from one share class to another. This is materialized by a linked redemption/subscription pair.**

- `accountId` must belong to `investorId` and must already hold an active line for `toShareClassId`; otherwise the order is rejected with `MissingAccountLineError`. Add the line with [POST /v0/accounts/{accountId}/lines](#tag/Accounts/operation/accounts.addAccountLine) and retry.
- The `quantity` field supports three modes:
  - `{"mode":"amount","amount":{"value":"1000","currency":"USD"}}` - swap a specific amount
  - `{"mode":"shares","shares":"10.5"}` - swap a specific number of shares
  - `{"mode":"total"}` - swap the whole position
- In `amount` mode, `amount.currency` **must** be the currency of `fromShareClassId` (`USD` for `SAFO`, `EUR` for `eurSAFO`, and so on). Any other currency, including the target share class currency, is rejected with an `ApplicationError` carrying `customErrorCode: "CurrencyNotSupported"`. A swap is always sized on the side it leaves from; the conversion to the target currency happens at execution.
- Not every pair of share classes can be swapped. An unavailable pair is rejected with `SwapNotAvailableError`, whose `reason` says why (`share-classes-not-swappable`, `no-conversion-path`, …).
- Where the two share classes are denominated in different currencies, the conversion is applied at execution using that day's rate. The rate is not known when the order is created, so it appears in `settlement.exchangeRate` only once the order reaches `executed`.
- The order stays `created` until both sides have been valued, then becomes `executed` and carries a `settlement` with both sides' amounts, shares and applied NAVs. Depending on the funds involved, the two sides are valued either on the same day or a few business days apart.

> **Distribute-with-Spiko's-license distributors** cannot place this order. Swap orders are not yet available through an [Investor JWT](/developers/distributor_api/technical_guides/investor_jwt).

**Returns every share class pair you have access to that supports a swap.**

- Both share classes of a returned pair are ones you can access, and the pair is one Spiko can currently convert. Use this to decide what to present: a pair absent from the list is a swap you should not offer.
- Pass `fromShareClassId` to get only the routes leaving one share class.
- A pair listed here is one [POST /v0/swap-orders/](#tag/Swap-orders/operation/swapOrders.createSwapOrder) accepts. The converse does not hold: that endpoint gates on convertibility and on the target account holding an active line, not on your access to the share classes, which is gated when the line is added. A pair absent here only for access reasons may therefore still be accepted.
- Whether a pair is swappable depends only on the two share classes, so this response is safe to cache per distributor. It says nothing about a particular investor: balance, an active account line on the destination account, and the investor's own fund access are checked when the order is placed.
